Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant to VP - Zaventem - Medical Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is an international medical technology company dedicated to improving patient outcomes through innovative, clinically proven solutions in key areas of care. They believe that ideas can come from anywhere, and they encourage employees at every level to make a difference.

Jobomschrijving

Provide full administrative support to the VP, including calendar management, prioritization of meetings, screening calls and emails, and coordinating daily tasks.

Prepare executive summaries, meeting pre-reads, and contract materials to ensure the VP is well-informed for all engagements.

Manage budgets, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and on-site logistics for off-site meetings and conferences in coordination with procurement.

Oversee business travel and visa arrangements, and ensure timely, accurate submission of expense reports.

Create polished PowerPoint presentations, respond professionally to internal and external inquiries, and maintain discretion with sensitive information.

Build and maintain strong relationships with global and external stakeholders, support strategic meetings, training, events, and team-building activities across Europe.

Develop robust knowledge of the business's structure, tools, policies, and key contacts, support sensitive employee matters, and ensure completion of required training.

Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Business or related field, or 10+ years of relevant experience.

Organizational & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong planning, attention to detail, ability to multitask, prioritize, and resolve issues independently.

Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, customer service mindset, and ability to build professional relationships.

Adaptability & Initiative: Flexible, proactive, self-motivated, and able to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments with minimal supervision.

Event & Meeting Coordination: Proven experience in organizing international meetings and internal events.

Languages & Team Spirit: Fluent in English and Dutch, all the other languages are a big plus. Team player, fast learner, and eager to collaborate and share knowledge.

The hiring organisation is a well-established European association representing companies across a specialised industrial sector. It plays a central role in supporting its members through major green, digital, and regulatory transformations, working closely with EU institutions, businesses, and expert groups. The association leads strategic initiatives, facilitates knowledge exchange, and supports long-term industry competitiveness and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide day-to-day support to the team manager.
• Track selected policy topics and assist in preparing brief inputs.
• Organise physical and virtual meetings, including agendas and follow-up.
• Handle travel planning and event logistics.
• Coordinate activities of working groups.
• Draft short reports and communication summaries.
• Update webpages, newsletters, and social media posts.
• Maintain contact lists, files, and member resources.

•  Degree in Office Management or similar,
• Relevant assistant experience is a must.
• Strong communication skills in English; other languages are a big plus.
• Confident with digital tools, websites, and social media.
• Skilled in Microsoft Office and collaborative platforms.
• Highly organised with strong prioritisation abilities.
• Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Calm and reliable under time pressure.

Our partner is part of an international company operating in the retail industry. To strengthen their Sales Support team, they are looking for a German-speaking Sales Support Specialist to assist both Account Managers and customers throughout their projects.

You will join a dynamic and sustainable work environment where growth, collaboration, and respect are at the heart of the company culture. Thanks to a structured onboarding program, you will quickly get up to speed and become a valued member of the team from day one.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

• You will work closely with our distributor network & managing projects.
• You will advise customers on the best solutions.
• Throughout each project, you will build and maintain strong commercial relationships with your customers.
• You will manage the entire order process, from design and quotation through to production, delivery, and after-sales follow-up.
• You will communicate daily with customers and suppliers to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
• You will handle customer complaints professionally by investigating issues and implementing appropriate solutions, working closely with the Account Manager when needed.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who:

• Has a strong customer focus and is passionate about delivering excellent service.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys learning new skills.
• Takes initiative and enjoys working on a variety of projects.
• Is organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
• Has a positive attitude and enjoys collaborating as part of a team.
• Has a hands-on mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
• Is fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch is a strong advantage.
• Is proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
The Commercial Coordinator role within the FMCG industry focuses on supporting sales, logistics, customer service operations in the beer sector. This position requires organisational skills to manage customer interactions and ensure smooth process optimizations.

Client Details

Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Description

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.

 

Concretely you will:

 

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process
 

 

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

Our client is a fast-growing B2B organization investing heavily in the optimization of its digital landscape. As part of this transformation, they are looking for a Freelance IT Business Process Lead to analyze, redesign, and document key business processes, with a strong focus on e-commerce and IT systems.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Business Process Lead your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.
• Assess the interaction between business processes and IT systems.
• Redesign and optimize workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
• Document business processes, functional flows, and system interactions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional process designs.
• Act as the interface between Business, IT, and external implementation partners.
• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.
• Identify opportunities for automation and continuous process improvement.

A successful Freelance Business Process Lead should have:

• Proven experience as an IT Business Process Lead, Functional Analyst, or Process Consultant.
• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

• Press brake operators
• Forklift drivers
